title: UIBK-Embedding: Effective Text Retrieval by Unifying Dense and Late-Interaction Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2610.27195v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Dense bi-encoders and late-interaction retrievers are usually treated as alternatives, yet they fail on different queries: one vector captures what a text is about, token-level matching finds its exact entities and phrases. Using both today means two models, two indexes and a score-fusion step. We present UIBK-Embedding-v1, a 179M-parameter English encoder that produces both representations in one pass and scores them with one unmodified MaxSim. The dense embedding is written into the list of token vectors as three extra vectors, and a one-dimensional tag keeps the two kinds of vectors from matching each other, so that plain MaxSim equals the token-level MaxSim plus a weighted dense cosine. The model therefore runs in a standard late-interaction index without changes; we test it with PLAID. translated_title: UIBK-Embedding：通过统一稠密检索与晚期交互检索实现高效文本检索
translated_abstract: 稠密双编码器和晚期交互检索器通常被视为两种备选方案，但它们会在不同的查询上失败：单个向量捕捉文本的主题内容，而词元级匹配则能找到文本中确切的实体和短语。目前若要同时使用两者，需要两个模型、两个索引以及一个分数融合步骤。我们提出了 UIBK-Embedding-v1，一个拥有1.79亿参数的英文编码器，它能通过一次前向传播同时生成两种表示，并使用一个未经修改的 MaxSim 对其进行打分。稠密嵌入被作为三个额外向量写入词元向量列表中，同时一个一维标签防止两类向量相互匹配，从而使普通的 MaxSim 等于词元级 MaxSim 加上加权的稠密余弦相似度。因此，该模型无需任何改动即可在标准晚期交互索引中运行；我们使用 PLAID 对其进行了测试。共享的18层主干网络、每个头独立的4层顶层，以及将交叉编码器蒸馏到融合分数中的方法，使两个头合并为一个检索器。
tldr: 该论文提出单一模型 UIBK-Embedding-v1，通过将稠密嵌入作为带标签的额外向量写入词元向量列表，使标准的 MaxSim 计算能同时融合稠密检索与词元级晚期交互检索两种优势，且无需修改即可直接在现有晚期交互索引（如PLAID）中运行。
en_tdlr: This paper presents UIBK-Embedding-v1, a single model that unifies dense and late-interaction retrieval by encoding the dense embedding as tagged extra token vectors, so an unmodified standard MaxSim fuses both retrieval signals and runs directly in existing late-interaction indexes such as PLAID.
